exposure: women who had a caesarean birth
women who had a vaginal birth
outcome: women's reflections on previous birth experiences
cohort: 6101 women who gave birth in Australia during 2016-2021 and responded to an open text question in the Birth Experience Study (BESt) online survey about what they would do differently if they were to have another baby
finding: Over 85% of women in Australia who responded to the survey expressed a desire to change aspects of their birth choices in future pregnancies, with many desiring more information, greater advocacy for their preferred birth experiences, and better access to continuity of care with a midwife.
mod_finding: Many women expressed a desire for a vaginal birth in future pregnancies, reflecting a growing awareness of the benefits of vaginal birth and a desire for greater autonomy in birth choices.
